purpose: Source and redistribution inventory for IFR terminal procedures and relevant VFR procedure geometry. This registry is not an operational data publication.

europe.summary: France publishes current procedure DATA sheets in its eAIP, including structured SID and STAR leg tables and some RNP approach precoding tables. Its separate SIA AIXM4.5/XML export is openly reusable reference data but is not yet treated as a complete IFPD feed. No complete Europe-wide IFR procedure dataset has been established.

sources.attribution: Service de l'Information Aeronautique (SIA France); include the source and last update date.
sources.notes: The SIA XML export is an openly reusable reference-data source (Licence Ouverte 2.0), useful for airports, runways, navaids and designated-point coordinates. Do not assume that this XML package contains complete IFR SID/STAR/approach leg sequences. France's published procedure tables are available separately as eAIP DATA PDFs and must be ingested and validated independently.

sources.jurisdiction: European regions; coverage varies by OFM region
sources.notes: OFMA FAQ permits use in an app that is sold when the General Users' License is followed. Coverage and completeness differ by region; do not promote these VFR vectors to IFR procedures.

The published air transport network includes airports, runways, navaids, points, routes and airspace; it is not the German IFR SID/STAR/approach publication. DFS states updates twice yearly and warns the data may contain errors or be incomplete.

sources.notes: EAD Basic is a limited general-purpose consultation tool and is not the operational EAD database. Commercial data/software providers re-serving EAD data fall under Type 3 charges and Member State royalties.
Do not copy Spanish AIP procedures into the public data repository until ENAIRE's current redistribution terms or a written permission grant has been reviewed.
Do not redistribute UK terminal procedures until the applicable Crown Copyright / NATS licence for extracted procedure data is verified.

format: PDF DATA tables embedded in official eAIP chart package
procedureScope: RNP approach DATA tables where complete non-FNA sheets are published
sources.license: SIA Licence Ouverte / Open Licence terms for products in the free-disposition catalogue; exact inclusion of each eAIP chart/PDF product must be confirmed before public redistribution
sources.attribution: Service de l'Information Aeronautique (SIA France); cite the source URL and last update date.
sources.notes: The current AIP's GEN 0.4 checklist identifies individual DATA SID, DATA STAR and DATA RWY precoding sheets. Example LFPG SID/STAR PDFs expose row-level path terminators, waypoint identifiers, fly-over flags, magnetic/true courses, distances, turn direction, altitude/IAS constraints and navigation accuracy. The importer stores these fields as published, keeps shared runway selectors unexpanded, and leaves coordinates unresolved unless linked to a unique source-backed fix. FNA-only final-approach sheets are excluded from the complete RNP approach pattern. Do not release extracted PDFs or derived data until the licence scope for the specific eAIP product has been confirmed.

asia.summary: Official AIP procedure material is accessible in several Asian states, but reviewed terms commonly restrict extraction, redistribution or commercial use without permission. This review covers Thailand, India, Singapore, Hong Kong and South Korea; no Asia-wide public commercial-redistribution IFR procedure source is confirmed.

sources.notes: CAAT terms expressly prohibit extracting, copying, storing, redistributing, republishing, adapting or commercially exploiting AIP material without authorization. Commercial app developers are told to contact CAAT.

AAI states its website material remains copyrighted and may not be reproduced or distributed without prior approval. AIM India terms also restrict certain AIP documents to AAI personnel's internal non-commercial use.

The AIP charts are freely viewable, but CAAS website terms limit downloads to one copy on one computer for the user's own personal, non-commercial use. Free access is not a commercial redistribution licence.

sources.license: AIP controlled-document terms; redistribution permission not established
sources.notes: The AIS site labels AIP products as controlled documents and warns that downloaded or copied copies are uncontrolled. No public commercial redistribution permission was established in this review.

sources.provider: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT), Republic of Korea
sources.notes: The current AIP states all content is MOLIT-copyrighted unless otherwise indicated; unauthorized reproduction/distribution is prohibited. Use for profit or equivalent benefit requires prior permission or consultation. Public viewing does not grant FlightTempo redistribution rights.
